facts.fact: Orange Egypt announced the inauguration of its Alexandria data center, launched together with its subscription-based Orange Business Cloud IaaS for corporate clients, built with Huawei; the document gives no event date other than its 2020-02-29 publication date, which is used.

systems.country_label: Orange Business Cloud data center, Alexandria

note: No cloud-region fact: Orange-operated cloud on Huawei technology, not a Huawei Cloud region stated.
